mapper.select: WITH T00 AS ( -- The closed sales order SELECT SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS OrderSite, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS ProjectQty, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO, COMPANY.ACCCUR_0 AS Currency, SORDERP.NETPRI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 * SORDER.CHGRAT_0 AS SalesAmount, SORDERP.NETPRI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 * SORDER.CHGRAT_0 * SORDER.ORDATI_0 / NULLIF(SORDER.ORDNOT_0, 0) AS SalesAmountWithTax FROM EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.COMPANY COMPANY ON COMPANY.MAIFCY_0 = SORDER.SALFCY_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0 AND SORDERQ.SOQSTA_0 = 3 -- Important, only closed sales order AND SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 = #{Site} AND ( SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 = #{ProjectNO} OR SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 = #{ProjectNO} ) ORDER BY OrderDate DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY ), T01 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T00.OrderSite, T00.OrderNO, T00.OrderLine, STOJOU.LOT_0 AS ProvideProjectNO, COUNT(STOJOU.SERNUM_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T00.ProjectNO, STOJOU.LOT_0 ) AS ProvideQty FROM T00 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SDELIVERYD SDELIVERYD ON SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 = T00.OrderNO AND SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 = T00.OrderLine INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.STOJOU STOJOU ON SDELIVERYD.STOFCY_0 = STOJOU.STOFCY_0 AND SDELIVERYD.SDHNUM_0 = STOJOU.VCRNUM_0 AND SDELIVERYD.SDDLIN_0 = STOJOU.VCRLIN_0 AND LEN (STOJOU.LOT_0) > 5 -- To skip misc projectNO ), T02 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T01.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO, SUM(PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T01.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ) AS ProvideTotalQty FROM T01 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR ON T01.ProvideProjectNO = OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 -- no site limit, for hongkong project, purchase by zhuhai INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP ON OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T01.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 AND ( PORDERP.ITMREF_0 = OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 -- PN same to sales order OR CHARINDEX (OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0) > 0 ) -- PNOG,SMEC, ITMDES1 maybe contains version INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 ), T03 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T00.ProjectNO, T00.OriProjectNO, T00.OrderSite, T00.PN, T00.OrderDate, T00.OrderNO, T00.OrderLine, T00.Currency, T00.SalesAmount, T00.SalesAmountWithTax, ( SUM(PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ) ) * T01.ProvideQty / NULLIF(T02.ProvideTotalQty, 0) AS Cost, ( SUM( PORDERQ.LINATI_0 * (PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0 / NULLIF(PORDERQ.LINAMT_0, 0)) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ) ) * T01.ProvideQty / NULLIF(T02.ProvideTotalQty, 0) AS CostWithTax FROM T00 INNER JOIN T01 ON T00.OrderNO = T01.OrderNO AND T00.OrderLine = T01.OrderLine INNER JOIN T02 ON T02.OrderSite = T01.OrderSite AND T02.ProvideProjectNO = T01.ProvideProjectNO INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP ON T01.ProvideProjectNO = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T01.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER AS PORDER ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 ), T10 AS ( -- The open sales order SELECT SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS OrderSite, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS ProjectQty, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO, COMPANY.ACCCUR_0 AS Currency, SORDERP.NETPRI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 * SORDER.CHGRAT_0 AS SalesAmount, SORDERP.NETPRI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 * SORDER.CHGRAT_0 * SORDER.ORDATI_0 / NULLIF(SORDER.ORDNOT_0, 0) AS SalesAmountWithTax FROM EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.COMPANY COMPANY ON COMPANY.MAIFCY_0 = SORDER.SALFCY_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0 AND SORDERQ.SOQSTA_0 != 3 -- Important, only open sales order AND SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 = #{Site} AND ( SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 = #{ProjectNO} OR SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 = #{ProjectNO} ) ORDER BY OrderDate DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY ), T11 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T10.ProjectNO, T10.OriProjectNO, T10.OrderSite, T10.PN, T10.OrderDate, T10.OrderNO, T10.OrderLine, T10.Currency, T10.SalesAmount, T10.SalesAmountWithTax, ( SUM(PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T10.OrderSite, T10.ProjectNO ) ) AS Cost, ( SUM( PORDERQ.LINATI_0 * (PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0 / NULLIF(PORDERQ.LINAMT_0, 0)) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T10.OrderSite, T10.ProjectNO ) ) AS CostWithTax FROM T10 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP ON ( T10.ProjectNO = PORDERP.PJT_0 OR T10.OriProjectNO = PORDERP.PJT_0 ) AND T10.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER AS PORDER ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 ) SELECT T03.*, T03.SalesAmount - T03.Cost AS Profit, T03.SalesAmountWithTax - T03.CostWithTax AS ProfitWithTax, T03.SalesAmount / NullIF(T03.Cost, 0) AS ProfitRate FROM T03 UNION SELECT T11.*, T11.SalesAmount - T11.Cost AS Profit, T11.SalesAmountWithTax - T11.CostWithTax AS ProfitWithTax, T11.SalesAmount / NullIF(T11.Cost, 0) AS ProfitRate FROM T11 ORDER BY OrderDate DESC
